name: @octopus-reef/adapter-scout
description: A thin, dependency-free HTTP client for a running octopus-scout — Reef CALLS Scout to pull governed web/PDF context at session open (robots + rate-limit + hash-dedup), rather than bundling the heavy ingestion service. Bring the trusted content in as a session observation.
author: Ran Tao <ran@octopusos.ai>
